claims.text: Use machine-learning models trained on high-entropy-alloy datasets as the intervention.
Machine-learning models can learn complex relationships between alloy composition and melting properties.
Learning composition–melting-property relationships enables machine-learning models to predict melting temperature more accurately than current methods.
Machine-learning models can predict melting properties more computationally efficiently than current methods.
The proposed models will achieve higher accuracy for melting-temperature and other melting-property predictions than current capabilities.
The proposed models will achieve greater computational efficiency than current melting-property prediction methods.
The expected performance requires a large and diverse training dataset of high-entropy alloys.
The proposed models' performance may vary with the quality and diversity of the training dataset.
The proposed models are limited to predicting melting properties of high-entropy alloys.
A held-out high-entropy-alloy dataset can be used to compare the proposed models with current prediction methods.
